name: Luna
subtitle: every Luna's planet
cover: The only planet without a moon.
beats: Luna is the only planet in the atlas without a moon, and it takes this personally.
The moon fund has raised enough for a large lamp on a pole. They point it at the sky on birthdays.
odd_line: Moon fund: three per cent of the way there.
story: Luna is the only planet in the atlas without a moon of its own, and it takes this very personally. Every spring there is a fund-raiser. So far they have raised enough for one large lamp on a tall pole, which is switched on and pointed at the sky for birthdays, anniversaries and anyone having a bad week.
rule: Do not mention other planets' moons in front of Luna.
question: Know a Luna? This one's theirs.
extra: The lamp has a waiting list. Birthdays get priority.
